summary: Tested Hotel Terme Leonardo redesign end-to-end. Backend: pytest 4/4 passing on /api/bookings (POST, GET, validation) and /api/ root. Frontend (viewport 1920x900): default IT hero, language switching IT/EN/DE/FR verified (nav-link-golf, hero H1, nav-book-btn label all update correctly), nav-book-btn and hero-book-btn are anchors with target='_blank' pointing to https://www.termeleonardo.com/it, Day Spa section present with 'Prenota Day Spa' anchor targeting https://www.termeleonardo.com/it/day-spa/prenotazioni in new tab, and booking-form submission returns booking-success panel (POST /api/bookings succeeded).
critical_code_review_comments: Booking model has no server-side email format validation (uses plain str). Consider pydantic EmailStr.
server.py mixes datetime serialization manually; consider a shared serializer helper for consistency across endpoints.
Language state is in-memory (React context) and resets on full page reload; consider persisting to localStorage for better UX.
seed_data_creation: Created test bookings prefixed with TEST_ via API and UI submission.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested features verified. Backend booking endpoint accepts payload matching BookingCreate schema and returns 200 with a Booking object (id, stato='ricevuta'). Language switching purely client-side via React context (LanguageContext + i18n.js). data-testids all present as documented.
